list.title: My ledgers
list.subtitle: Switching takes every page with it
list.footnote: A ledger you create is yours to own; one you join with a code makes you a member, who cannot change the base currency or the member list.

card.role_line_owner: You're the owner · can invite and delete
card.role_line_member: You're a member · someone invited you

new_card.title: New ledger
new_card.body: One for a trip, one for your parents. Ledgers are completely independent.

onboarding.title: Start with a ledger
onboarding.body: Transactions, accounts and statistics all hang off a ledger. Create one, or join someone else’s with the invite code they gave you.
onboarding.footnote: You can be in several ledgers at once — “Household” and “Travel”, say.

create.title: New ledger
create.body: You'll be the owner: pick a name and a base currency, then generate invite codes for the family.
create.body_short: You'll be the owner, set the currency, invite others

join.title: Join with an invite code
join.body: They generate a 6-digit code in their ledger settings; entering it makes you a member of that ledger.
join.body_short: They generate a 6-digit code in their ledger settings

create.title: New ledger
create.subtitle: A ledger holds everything: its transactions, accounts and statistics.
create.base_currency_hint: Every amount is converted into it for statistics. It cannot be changed later.
create.limit_reached: You've reached the limit of 10 ledgers

join.title: Join a ledger
join.code_hint: They generate it in their ledger settings; a code is valid for 10 minutes
join.paste_hint: Pasting fills all six cells · digits only

benefits.title: Once you join
benefits.one: You can see every transaction and account in this ledger.
benefits.two: You can add, import and recategorise — but not change the base currency or the members.
benefits.three: Your own ledgers are untouched; you can switch back any time.

join.rate_limited_countdown: Too busy right now — retrying in {{seconds}}s

members.title: Members
members.remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? Their entries stay in the ledger.

permission.title: Permissions
permission.member_line: Members: record entries, manage accounts, import and undo imports.
permission.owner_line: Only the owner can generate invite codes, remove members, rename the ledger, change its base currency, transfer ownership and delete the ledger.

invite.title: Invite code
invite.idle_hint: An invite code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once. The other person enters it on their ledger list.
invite.revoke_confirm: Once revoked, this code stops working immediately.
invite.expired: This code has expired - generate a new one
invite.retry_hint: The code can be entered as often as needed while it is valid - a typo locks nothing.
invite.countdown_label: Time left on the invite code

currency.title: Base currency · {{code}} {{name}}
currency.subtitle: Every conversion, the net worth and the category totals follow it
currency.warning_title: Changing the base currency re-converts all history
currency.warning_body: All {{count}} transactions will be re-converted at each one's own rate on its date, reproducibly. Original amounts and currencies never change, so switching back brings the numbers back too.
currency.read_only_hint: Only the owner can rename the ledger or change its base currency

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.transfer_sub: Hand it over and become an ordinary member
danger.transfer_sub_none: Nobody else is in this ledger yet
danger.transfer_confirm: Transfer ownership to {{name}}? You'll become an ordinary member afterward.
danger.leave_sub: Your entries stay in the ledger; you'll need a new invite code to come back
danger.leave_sub_owner: The owner has to transfer ownership before leaving
danger.leave_confirm: Leave "{{name}}"? Your entries stay in the ledger, and you'll need a new invite code to come back.
danger.delete_sub: Deletes all {{count}} transactions with it. This can't be undone
danger.delete_confirm_body: This can't be undone. Every other member loses access at the same time.
danger.delete_confirm_label: Type the ledger name to confirm — {{name}}
danger.delete_hint: Type "{{name}}" exactly to unlock the button
danger.delete_mismatch: That is not the ledger's name
